{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to secp256k1 build files are part of imported subtree code rather than improvements to Core build or CI infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not affect Bitcoin Core build or CI systems directly."
    },
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches doc/descriptors.md and doc/psbt.md solely to document the accompanying CISA changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Documentation updates are secondary additions to the descriptor and PSBT code changes."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches src/kernel/chainparams.cpp mechanically to define regtest deployment parameters.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not touch the kernel API or library boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/policy/policy.cpp and src/policy/policy.h to define standardness rules for CISA witness version 2 transactions.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Defines relay and mempool standardness policy for proposed BIP460 CISA transactions. While worthwhile as part of testing the draft proposal, policy changes for experimental soft forks are reasonably deferrable pending consensus decisions."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/mining_basic.py only as a side effect of transaction standardness adjustments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Makes no changes to block template construction or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/p2p_segwit.py without changing P2P protocol logic, message processing, or networking code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter peer-to-peer transport or network message handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC modifications expose wallet and transaction signing behavior rather than changing RPC infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "RPC changes are secondary interfaces to wallet and consensus functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test helper additions in test/functional/test_framework/cisa.py are specific to testing CISA rather than general test infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Test files test the feature itself rather than modifying core testing frameworks or harnesses."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Subtree files under src/secp256k1/ import experimental unmerged upstream modules rather than a maintained subtree update.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Vendored secp256k1 modules accompany the draft BIP reference implementation and are developed upstream in libsecp256k1."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus rules in src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/validation.cpp for BIP460 witness version 2 script execution and signature verification.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides a reference implementation for BIP460 cross-input signature aggregation consensus rules to address linear fee growth in multi-input Taproot spends. As a reference implementation accompanying early draft BIPs (restricted to regtest), review is valuable for protocol evaluation but reasonably deferrable."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds `cisa()` descriptor parsing in src/script/descriptor.cpp, PSBT aggregation handling in src/psbt.cpp, and signing logic in src/wallet/.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds wallet signing, descriptor support, and PSBT workflows for aggregated multi-input transactions. The functionality provides a clear use case for collaborative transactions like CoinJoin and Payjoin, though deployment is deferrable while the underlying specification is in draft."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
